landscape.title: Where CampusConnect fits.
landscape.vs_forms_desc: Great for one event. Falls apart across a year, across clubs, across handoffs.
landscape.vs_discord_desc: Perfect for chatter. Not designed to be a source of truth for membership or attendance.
landscape.vs_eventbrite_desc: Solid for the general public. Doesn't understand semesters, clubs, or student verification.
landscape.vs_portals_desc: Locked to one campus, no interop, no open-source community driving improvements.

integrations.title: Plays nice with the tools you already use.

items.a1: CampusConnect is a unified, open-source platform designed to streamline student club management, event planning, and digital check-ins for student communities.
items.a2: Yes! CampusConnect is 100% open-source and free for student communities. You can host your own instance or use the managed cloud version.
items.q3: How do I create a new club?
items.a3: Registered students can request to create a new club from the Clubs Directory. Once approved by a system administrator, you can start customizing your page.
items.q4: How do I manage my club members?
items.a4: Club admins can approve join requests, assign roles (member, admin), and view full member profiles directly from the club settings.
items.q5: How do I RSVP for an event?
items.a5: Simply explore the active events feed, select the event you're interested in, and click the 'RSVP' button.
items.q6: How does the check-in system work?
items.a6: When you RSVP, a custom ticket with a QR code is generated. Club organizers can scan your QR code at the door using any mobile device to check you in instantly.
items.a7: Absolutely. CampusConnect is built with Supabase authentication and strict Row-Level Security (RLS) database policies to protect user and admin data.
items.q8: Who can see my personal profile details?
items.a8: Only authorized members of your verified student community can see your profile page. You can customize your preferences at any time in your Settings.
